svg.title: Explaining a proof after corruption
svg.desc: A zero-knowledge simulator publishes a proof without a witness. Later, a valid witness becomes available upon corruption. Retained state and a generator trapdoor allow reconstruction of randomness that reproduces the original proof.
svg.text: The simulator does not know a witness.
A valid witness w is now available.
Generate π and retain private state.
Compute randomness r for π and w.
